## Scope

- Target/base SHA:
- Final SHA:
- Rollback SHA/branch:

## Contracts

- [ ] Safety codes and 3 m / 5 m / 0.8 m geometry unchanged, or change explained
- [ ] Message schema unchanged, or migration explained
- [ ] Configuration changes listed
- [ ] Persistent-map/static-evidence lifecycle reviewed

## Validation

- [ ] `git diff --check`
- [ ] Repository regression scripts
- [ ] Ubuntu clean catkin build
- [ ] Ubuntu unit tests
- [ ] Sequential Bag validation (if applicable)
- [ ] Server validation (if applicable)

Unavailable environment-specific checks must be marked **not run**, never
reported as passed.
